serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I’m in the mood for a walk right now. I need to take a deep breath for just a moment at least.
It’s not like I’m particularly more stressed than usual or anything. I just have that unexplainable need to go around and lurk a little.
At this hour streets are pretty packed up. It’s not my favourite time of the day to do it, since people tend to bump into me…
???: Watch where you are going! {{punch}}
That’s exactly what I was talking about. All of these wage slaves tend to be on edge during working hours. If you look at them the wrong way or take too much time with the ATM they will lash out on you.
